note: Calories only, as printed beside each dish; dishes with none (mostly alcohol) are not listed. The London, Manchester and Vardo menus differ, so a dish is listed only if its calories and allergens match on every menu that prints it (35 left out). Coffees exclude milk. The chain's 'Deep Fat Fryer' mark (a shared fryer) is not in the allergen list.
